analysis.title: Deutsche Bank Research, Europe (daily recommendation and target price digest, 24 Nov 2026)
key_insights: Norsk Hydro upgraded to Buy from Hold, TP cut to NOK86 from NOK90 (last close NOK65.06). Shares are down 20% vs SXPP and 25% vs aluminium YTD, with volume growth (Slovalco, Qatalum) and up to NOK4bn pa energy savings as offsets to 2027 aluminium price normalisation.

2027 Mining Outlook cuts targets across the sector: Anglo American Buy 4200p (from 4700p), BHP Hold 2650p (from 2900p), Rio Tinto Hold 6900p (from 7600p), Glencore Buy 620p (from 680p), Freeport Buy USD70 (from USD80), Teck Buy USD67 (from USD77). DB cites the AI trade unwind and tighter financial conditions, but expects copper prices to recover in 2027.

Copper is described as caught between a weakening macro backdrop and a very tight physical market. The USD direction and whether US inventories flow back into the global market are the key near-term signals.

Glencore Investor Update on 7 December is the next catalyst. Focus is on the copper growth path (return to 1 mtpa by 2028), disposals and cost guidance. DB cuts 2026/27 EBITDA by an average of 6% and sees energy exposure as a hedge against a prolonged Gulf conflict.
ABB (Hold, TP CHF74 from CHF76) is buying Ziehl-Abegg for an EV of $2.65bn at 18.6x 2026e EV/EBITDA vs ABB's own 16.8x. DB sees about 0.5% EPS dilution in year 1, with closing expected in H2 2027.
Crest Nicholson (Hold) TP cut to 45p from 65p. FY26 PBT is moved to -£53m from -£24m, and there is still no covenant waiver beyond the 30/11 deadline, so refinancing risk is high.

European steel: ArcelorMittal Buy TP USD77 (from USD78). Stocks are about 30% below September highs and EV/EBITDA is 4.7x, c.20% below midcycle. The new EU safeguard tool and CBAM support spreads. Top picks are Salzgitter, ArcelorMittal and Aperam.

Pharma Rx trackers (IQVIA data to 13 Nov) flag Rx-implied variance vs consensus. Roche has upside on Actemra, Vabysmo, Perjeta and Hemlibra. Novartis has downside on Scemblix, Kisqali, Promacta and Entresto. Novo has downside on Oral Wegovy and Rybelsus. Sanofi has upside on Dupixent and Lovenox.
Roche CEO call shows robust confidence in revenue growth with operating leverage and optimism on the Wilserdly/giredestrant launch. Roche stays Buy with TP CHF500.
Lindt (Sell, TP CHF78000) expects global pricing down low-to-mid single digits in 2027, with larger cuts in Europe. Margin improvement is guided at only 0-40bps.
Tecan (Hold) sees Life Science Tools recovery broadening. China is improving, with some peers back to positive growth for the first time in ten quarters.

HPE (Buy, TP USD68, last close USD48.02) had a strong Q4/26. FY26 revenue was $46.7B (+36%), non-GAAP EPS $3.97, orders +72%, the quarterly dividend rose 19% to $0.17, and about $3B of buybacks are targeted for 2027.

Humana (Buy, TP USD516, last close USD383.68) hosts an investor update on 10 December. DB expects 2028 EPS to exceed the earlier ~$40 target and possibly top $50, driven partly by one-time gains the company will not quantify.

European banks 2027 outlook: RoTE is above 15% and rising. DB likes the sector and sees deratings as entry points, but flags exogenous stress risks from geopolitics, higher rates and a packed political calendar.
Equity tokenization report: US equity market structure faces its first major change in about 20 years, from tokenization, decentralized trading, perpetual futures, event contracts and 24x7 markets.

Cerillion (Buy, TP 1200p, last close 850p) reported FY26 revenue of £46.5m (+3%) and adj EBITDA of £21.1m, in line with the revised range. Porsche AG (Buy, TP EUR55) management meeting showed increased confidence in FCF and brand monetization.
Steel spread tracker shows EU and US prices still rising. Salzgitter TP EUR70, ArcelorMittal TP EUR70, Aperam TP EUR63, all Buy.

US flu season is running early and strong. Cumulative hospitalization through week 45 is the highest since 2010-11, and the CDC forecasts 1.2-4.8x year-on-year hospital admissions for the week ending 5 December.
European real estate: Continental REITs trade at a ~31% NTA discount and the UK at ~20%. Average P/E is 12.2x vs a 5Y average of 13.7x. CA Immo (Hold, TP EUR22) proposes a EUR1.50 special dividend.

earnings_insights: HPE reported Q4/26 and FY26: revenue $46.7B (+36%), non-GAAP operating margin 15%, non-GAAP EPS $3.97, orders +72%, non-GAAP EPS guidance raised c.16%.
Cerillion reported FY26: revenue £46.5m (+3% yoy), adj EBITDA £21.1m (45.5% margin), net cash £34.7m, total DPS 16.7p (+8%).
Norcros H1 reported: LFL revenue +1.5%, LFL EBIT -6% (reported +12%) to £24.6m. FY27 EBIT guided in line with consensus range £53.0-54.7m.
Crest Nicholson: DB cuts FY26 PBT estimate to -£53m from -£24m, including £10-15m of NRV provisions.
Humana: DB estimate 2026E EPS bottoming at ~$10, 2028 EPS above $40 and possibly above $50. Investor update on 10 December.
MONY Group trading update expected 2 December. DB est adjusted EBITDA £145.5m vs consensus £146m and guided range £140m-£148m.
Glencore Investor Update on 7 December. DB cuts 2026/27 EBITDA forecasts by an average of 6%.
ABB: Ziehl-Abegg deal expected to add c.3.5% to revenues and dilute EPS by c.0.5% in year 1 (DB estimate).
crypto_views: DB brokers report argues equity tokenization, blockchain-based trading, decentralized trading platforms, perpetual futures and event contracts are driving the first major US market structure change since the 1995-2005 electronification era.
